Choose a guide

Pentatonic scales ↗

Practice A minor pentatonic with an interactive guitar fretboard. Learn the five positions, find root notes and connect patterns with Fretboard Hero.

Fretboard notes ↗

Find notes across the guitar neck with Fretboard Hero. Start with A, use octave landmarks and check your recall with the fretboard quiz.

Triads ↗

Understand major and minor guitar triads with Fretboard Hero. Locate roots, thirds and fifths and practice inversions on groups of three strings.

Daily routine ↗

Build a focused guitar session with Fretboard Hero: root notes, scales, triads, rhythm and pentatonic movement in one key. Try the A minor demo.

Choose what you want to practice

Start with pentatonic scales if you know a box shape but struggle to move along the neck. Use the Fretboard Map if you want to find a note quickly. Explore triads to connect small chord shapes to the notes inside them.

  • Pentatonic scales: show all five positions or isolate one shape.
  • Triads: explore major and minor shapes and their inversions.
  • Fretboard Map: locate a note across the strings.
  • Daily Routine: move through five exercises in one key.
  • Quiz, tuner and Circle of Fifths: test your recall, tune up and explore harmony.

A practical companion to your guitar lessons

The app is useful when you want focused repetition between lessons or a visual explanation of the neck. It is not a complete video course or a song library. You choose a concept, inspect the notes and apply it on your own instrument.

For a first session, open the A minor pentatonic, find the root notes, then play one short phrase. You can use the tools with an acoustic or electric guitar in standard tuning.

One app, several ways to learn

The web app also includes bass and ukulele profiles. Their necks and available shapes follow the selected instrument. These guides focus on six-string guitar in standard tuning; choose your instrument from the app home screen.

Questions before you start

Do I need an account to try it?

No account is required to explore the web demo. Store purchases are handled through the relevant store account.

Does the app listen to my guitar?

The tuner and supported Daily Routine exercises can use microphone input. The visual map and Learn tools work without a microphone. Audio is processed on your device, as described in the privacy policy.

FRETBOARD HERO

Start with the free demo

The demo lets you explore the key of A, with an A minor Daily Routine and the note A on the Fretboard Map. Learn includes pentatonic positions, triads and chord shapes; the Circle of Fifths is also open. Additional notes and keys require full access. The Android app offers a one-time in-app purchase, with no subscription. Check the app for the current price and purchase terms.

Open the app

Try the web app in your browser or use the Android app. Microphone feedback depends on your browser, device and permission; you can also practice without it. An iOS App Store release is not yet linked from this site.
